faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Ordnance Factory Dehu Road Tenure Based DBW recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 20-08-2026. Applications must reach the specified address by this date.

faq.answer: There are a total of 14 vacancies announced for the Tenure Based DBW position at Ordnance Factory Dehu Road.

faq.answer: Candidates must be ex-apprentices of AOCP trade or its feeder trades from Ordnance Factories or Government/Private ITI affiliated organizations.

faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 40 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 19,900 Per Month plus Dearness Allowance (DA).

faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply offline by sending their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.answer: The selection process includes NCTVT (NAC) Exam, Trade Test/Practical Test, Document Verification, and finally, the Merit List.
